mutations.name: no DISALLOWED arm
mutations.find: WHEN NOT (required = ANY (art.rights)) THEN 'DISALLOWED'

mutations.name: no corrected arm
mutations.find: WHEN corrected IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFLICTING'

mutations.name: corrected read as STALE
mutations.find: WHEN corrected IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFLICTING'
mutations.replace: WHEN corrected IS NOT NULL THEN 'STALE'

mutations.name: no disagreeing arm
mutations.find: WHEN disagreeing IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFLICTING'

mutations.name: no FALSIFIED arm
mutations.find: WHEN art.validation = 'FALSIFIED' THEN 'CONFLICTING'

mutations.name: no horizon arm
mutations.find: WHEN art.horizon_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND art.horizon_ends_at < cov.assessed_at THEN 'STALE'

mutations.name: horizon compared inclusively
mutations.find: art.horizon_ends_at < cov.assessed_at THEN 'STALE'

mutations.name: no withdrawn arm
mutations.find: WHEN withdrawn IS NOT NULL THEN 'STALE'

mutations.name: DISALLOWED arm below the CONFLICTING arms
mutations.find:
WHEN NOT (required = ANY (art.rights)) THEN 'DISALLOWED'
    WHEN corrected IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFLICTING'
    WHEN disagreeing IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFLICTING'
    WHEN art.validation = 'FALSIFIED' THEN 'CONFLICTING'
mutations.replace:
WHEN corrected IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFLICTING'
    WHEN disagreeing IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFLICTING'
    WHEN art.validation = 'FALSIFIED' THEN 'CONFLICTING'
    WHEN NOT (required = ANY (art.rights)) THEN 'DISALLOWED'

mutations.name: STALE arms above the FALSIFIED arm
mutations.find:
WHEN art.validation = 'FALSIFIED' THEN 'CONFLICTING'
    WHEN art.horizon_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND art.horizon_ends_at < cov.assessed_at THEN 'STALE'
mutations.replace:
WHEN art.horizon_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND art.horizon_ends_at < cov.assessed_at THEN 'STALE'
    WHEN art.validation = 'FALSIFIED' THEN 'CONFLICTING'

mutations.name: retraction instant ignored
mutations.find: WHERE r.issued_at <= cov.assessed_at) AS taken_back;

mutations.name: retraction instant exclusive
mutations.find: WHERE r.issued_at <= cov.assessed_at) AS taken_back;

mutations.find:

  AFTER INSERT ON dossier_coverage_evidence
  DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION refuse_coverage_unlike_its_evidence();

mutations.name: conclusion guard ignores the facet
mutations.find: JOIN dossier_facet f ON f.dossier_id = r.dossier_id AND f.facet = NEW.facet
mutations.replace: JOIN dossier_facet f ON f.dossier_id = r.dossier_id

mutations.name: conclusion guard ignores the release
mutations.find: WHERE r.dossier_release_id = NEW.dossier_release_id AND e.assessment = 'PRESENT'

mutations.name: conclusion guard accepts anything but DISALLOWED
mutations.find: WHERE r.dossier_release_id = NEW.dossier_release_id AND e.assessment = 'PRESENT'

mutations.name: conclusion guard ignores when the assessment was made
mutations.find: JOIN dossier_coverage c ON c.dossier_facet_id = f.dossier_facet_id AND c.assessed_at <= r.built_at
mutations.replace: JOIN dossier_coverage c ON c.dossier_facet_id = f.dossier_facet_id

mutations.name: conclusion guard excludes the build instant
mutations.find: JOIN dossier_coverage c ON c.dossier_facet_id = f.dossier_facet_id AND c.assessed_at <= r.built_at
mutations.replace: JOIN dossier_coverage c ON c.dossier_facet_id = f.dossier_facet_id AND c.assessed_at < r.built_at

mutations.name: level CHECK removed
mutations.find:
CONSTRAINT coverage_level_counts_the_present CHECK (level = CASE
    WHEN artifacts_present = 0 THEN 'NONE'
    WHEN artifacts_present >= 2 AND runs_usable >= 2 THEN 'SUPPORTED'
    ELSE 'THIN' END),

mutations.name: level CHECK ignores runs
mutations.find: WHEN artifacts_present >= 2 AND runs_usable >= 2 THEN 'SUPPORTED'

mutations.name: rollup CHECK removed
mutations.find:
CONSTRAINT coverage_assessment_is_the_rollup CHECK (assessment = CASE
    WHEN artifacts_available = 0 THEN 'MISSING'
    WHEN artifacts_conflicting > 0 THEN 'CONFLICTING'
    WHEN artifacts_stale > 0 THEN 'STALE'
    WHEN artifacts_disallowed > 0 THEN 'DISALLOWED'
    ELSE 'PRESENT' END)

mutations.name: rollup order: DISALLOWED before STALE
mutations.find:
WHEN artifacts_stale > 0 THEN 'STALE'
    WHEN artifacts_disallowed > 0 THEN 'DISALLOWED'
mutations.replace:
WHEN artifacts_disallowed > 0 THEN 'DISALLOWED'
    WHEN artifacts_stale > 0 THEN 'STALE'

mutations.name: rollup order: STALE before CONFLICTING
mutations.find:
WHEN artifacts_conflicting > 0 THEN 'CONFLICTING'
    WHEN artifacts_stale > 0 THEN 'STALE'
mutations.replace:
WHEN artifacts_stale > 0 THEN 'STALE'
    WHEN artifacts_conflicting > 0 THEN 'CONFLICTING'

mutations.name: counts-add-up CHECK removed
mutations.find: CONSTRAINT coverage_counts_add_up CHECK (artifacts_present + artifacts_stale + artifacts_conflicting + artifacts_disallowed = artifacts_available),

mutations.name: names-what-it-counts CHECK removed
mutations.find: CONSTRAINT coverage_names_what_it_counts CHECK (cardinality(artifact_ids) = artifacts_available),

mutations.name: runs CHECK: more runs than artifacts allowed
mutations.find: runs_represented <= artifacts_available AND (runs_represented = 0) = (artifacts_available = 0)

mutations.name: runs CHECK: artifacts from no run allowed
mutations.find: runs_represented <= artifacts_available AND (runs_represented = 0) = (artifacts_available = 0)

mutations.name: runs CHECK: more usable runs than present artifacts allowed
mutations.find: AND runs_usable <= artifacts_present AND runs_usable <= runs_represented AND (runs_usable = 0) = (artifacts_present = 0)

mutations.name: runs CHECK: more usable runs than runs allowed
mutations.find: AND runs_usable <= artifacts_present AND runs_usable <= runs_represented AND (runs_usable = 0) = (artifacts_present = 0)

mutations.name: runs CHECK: a present artifact from no usable run allowed
mutations.find: AND runs_usable <= artifacts_present AND runs_usable <= runs_represented AND (runs_usable = 0) = (artifacts_present = 0)
mutations.replace: AND runs_usable <= artifacts_present AND runs_usable <= runs_represented

mutations.name: evidence may be MISSING
mutations.find: AND assessment <> 'MISSING'),
